parsed.notes:
“Who you are” and “What we're looking for” supply required qualifications; “While not required, these are a plus:” supplies optional qualifications. Responsibilities-only skills are excluded.
The Snowflake/dbt/Looker/Tableau examples are read as alternatives for the modern-data-tool ask; Looker is unmapped and therefore has no expected criterion. The machine-learning framework examples form the second group. Conjunctive “including ... and ...” lists are left ungrouped.
Generic AI tools are not assumed to be AI coding tools or workflow-automation platforms. Predictive modeling is not assumed to mean AI model training.
Marketing techniques are retained as unmapped technical practices; industry background, LTV/CAC domain knowledge, business acumen, and communication are excluded.
Data science is explicitly requested in the optional code-quality bullet; the role title alone is not used to make that skill required.
